blocks.text: Asset Exposure Management (AEM) violation tickets aggregate related policy violations into a single work item that can be fixed as one task. Selecting a violation ticket from the Violation Tickets page opens the violation ticket's drawer, where you can view detailed information and perform multiple actions for the violation ticket. To learn more, see About Violation Tickets.
The actions you can perform in the violation ticket drawer depend on your user role in AEM. To learn more, see Understanding System Roles and Creating Custom Roles.
To view the violation ticket drawer:

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Assets in the top navigation bar.
In the left-side navigation, click Violation Tickets.
Click the violation ticket you want to view.
